# Legacy fixture provenance

`confirm-subset.jsonl` contains verbatim rows from the first three cells in
`bench/slotexp-validation/raw/confirm.jsonl` in the read-only
`2026-10-19-pre-harness` evidence archive. The source file's SHA-256 from
`bench-files.sha256` is
`95b90878927a60a270ef00da2bccfc75f0732d56276bba3e32e327bd0505e8e4`.

`confirm-analysis.json` is the corresponding three-cell subset of
